check.claim: The mpeg_card.bin image Beetle Saturn loads changes what the Saturn BIOS shows and does for a Video CD.
check.method: Saturn BIOS v1.01 (Japan), region forced to Japan, Video CD Card option enabled, automatic RTC left on and the host clock running (no libfaketime), to test whether runs repeat, the authored Video CD inserted. 3000 frames; Saturn A (libretro B) held 15 frames from frame 1300, which is Play on the BIOS CD player, and Start 15 frames from frame 1900. Repeated with each mpeg_card.bin image, with no file, with 512 KiB of zeros and with a 1-byte file; every other input is identical. Each variant runs twice in fresh processes.

result.statement: video_sha1 is not settled in 11 of 11 variants (mpeg_card.bin, mpeg_card.bin.3fee63d4, mpeg_card.bin.80179c49, mpeg_card.bin.821af2bd, mpeg_card.bin.b60e8866, mpeg_card.bin.b7450812, mpeg_card.bin.ee821d3f, mpeg_card.bin.ef9de845, mpeg_card.bin-absent, zeros_512k.bin, one_byte.bin): no comparison is drawn
